engine: Composite V11 of the day/night canon — the MASKED-WINDOW GLOW. The building stays in DAY the whole time; only the WINDOWS turn to night, each lighting at its own staggered threshold, like a house switching its lamps on room by room at dusk. Adds NO new motion engine: it builds the canon daynight-engine with mode:'manual' reveal:'opacity', PINS the night layer at opacity 0 so the daytime building stays visible, and drops one absolutely-positioned crop of the night render per window over the day building; set(t) fades each window's opacity 0->1 across its own band, eased, with a warm lamp glow that rises with it. NO WebGL, NO mix-blend, NO mask blending, NO canvas — opacity / gradient only.

drives_canon_with.night_layer: pinned at opacity 0 (the full night frame never shows; only the per-window crops light up)
drives_canon_with.note: the canon supplies the day/night layer plumbing + the PURE t; the composite owns the per-window thresholds and the lamp glow. dn.set(0) is kept so the day building stays fully lit beneath.

dayMedia.what: url | selector | element — the day still (canon bottom layer, stays visible the whole time).

nightMedia.what: url | selector | element — the night still, identical composition; its crops are what light up in the windows.

windows.what: [{ x,y,w,h,t0 }] in % of the stage; each window shows its matching night crop and lights at t0 .. t0+band.

band.what: the t span over which a single window warms from dark to fully lit (smoothstep). Smaller = snappier lamps; larger = softer.

glow.what: the warm lamp glow colour pooled around each lit window (::after radial blur). false = no glow.

--dnw-glow.what: warm amber lamp glow per window (radial-gradient in .dnw__win::after).

z-index.what: .dnw__win sits above day(1) + pinned night(2) + glow/scrim(3).

win_radius.what: soften the crop edge so it reads as light, not a pasted sticker.

glow_blur.what: static blur on the small glow box (NOT a scrub property).

crop_math.background-size: (10000 / w)% x (10000 / h)% — sizes the night image to the WHOLE stage so the box shows its slice at 1:1 registration with the day building.
crop_math.background-position: (x / (100 - w) * 100)% x (y / (100 - h) * 100)% — the standard CSS percentage-position formula that maps a box's % offset to the matching crop.

entry: DayNightMaskedWindows.create(target, opts) -> { root, dn, set(t), get(), windows, destroy }. target = element/selector. set(t) lights each window whose t0 <= t (eased across band); get() recovers t from the first window; dn = the underlying canon api; windows = the lit <i> nodes.
law: opacity + gradient only; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop / NO WebGL / NO mask-image blending / NO canvas drawImage; the day building stays fully visible (dn pinned at 0). prefers-reduced-motion -> windows static lit (no driver). Frame-match rule inherited (day and night geometry-identical). Requires the canon (window.DayNight) loaded FIRST. Sets window.__LAB_OK__.
proven: lab: OUR exterior day/night pair (renders/dn-ext-day.webp + dn-ext-night.webp), 16:9 zero-crop frame. The day house loads; a slider / autoplay drives t 0->1 and the windows light in sequence — carport (t0 0.00) -> left -> centre -> right -> far-right (t0 0.62) — each with a warm amber glow that rises with it, while the daytime building never changes beneath. 'Показати ще раз' replays; fully interactive. opacity-only = GPU.
